transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I can sign off on the operating and privacy plan for the morning announcement broadcast pilot, I need to complete the required review round. Mr. Greene, could you please provide me with the exact list of trained host students? Ms. Novak, I'll need the exact approved platform settings from you. And Mr. Ellis, I'll need the exact privacy restrictions and required records. Once I have all three of those, I can record the factual bases for the final plan and approve it. Let's get started.
